statement: A replica operation that retires a source replica (REMOVE, or the source-retirement phase of REPLACE) rests terminal only when the retired replica's ACTIVE services row is gone, and a lost retirement write is detected and cured by reconcile through owner-authorized paths; a terminal record can never durably coexist with the live source actuals it claims to have removed, so the operation-ledger quorum-spread hold cannot stay engaged forever against stale actuals.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
The cure must flow through owner-authorized destruction paths; do not weaken the priority surplus-REMOVE fence, count/diversity monotonic safety, or quorum admission to release the hold.

Two independent in-process repros archived under solve/report/ledger-surplus-drain-stale-actuals-2026-08-22/ and recorded as findings on formation-ledger-spread-voter-ready-readiness-closure: (a) surplus REMOVE of the seed's replica_operations-p1 replica terminal (workflow_step REMOVED/status removed) with the seed retaining two ACTIVE services rows -> concentration evaluator reports overTarget/concentrated forever and provisioning admission wedges (~50% of user-table-metadata-fanout runs; that test now goes red with owner evidence when it manifests); (b) join-time REPLACE terminal with the source ACTIVE row surviving -> cluster rests at 4 active voters, no REMOVE planned across 90s. Suspect seam: replica-operation-observed-completion.js hasObservedRetiredReplaceSourceReplica and the workflow executor-outcome reconcile.

The Face B cure scope must not just make the anti-entropy sweep reachable; the detection-to-cure interaction needs one owner: the component that detects cache/authoritative divergence (today: bootstrap-topology-snapshot-owner, which only logs) and the component that cures it (cdc-integration-service applyAuthoritativeCacheSweep) are separate owners with unowned wiring. Follow the CL-001 variant D precedent (consumer-triggered, cooldown-limited, owner-read hydration) and record which owner holds the trigger decision as part of the attempt.
